profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at H-E-B
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in JavaScript, ReactJS, Redux, HTML, and CSS. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Engineering from University of Florida.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - PowerAI Vision
positions.description:
User Interface developer for PowerAI Vision, a product used to label, train, and deploy deep learning vision models.

• Created the user interface from the ground up to deliver a product in four months.
• Led the front end development team in sprint planning, triaging, issue grooming, and prioritization.
• Developed a large portion of the UI code base, which included essential Computer Vision functionality, such as image and video labeling and dataset management.
• Structured the core React application, setup the development and build environment, and implemented all Redux functionality in the product.
• Worked with UX, sales, and solutions architect teams to compile user pain points and prioritize them along with other deliverables for each release.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - PowerVC
positions.description:
User Interface developer for PowerVC, a virtualization management solution for creating scalable, private clouds on Power Systems.

• Worked as a member of the user interface team to develop the presentation layer using JavaScript and Dojo Toolkit.
• Owned the implementation of all cloud networking functionality in the UI through all release cycles, which involved close collaboration with the Network API and UX team.
• Improved team productivity by building reusable widgets and creating several Python scripts to automate coding processes.
